target_customer: Affluent buyers wanting a share in large recreational ranches, in groups of ten or fewer
problem: Large recreational land parcels are valuable but costly and hard for one owner to buy and manage.
business_model: Sale of fractional ownership plus an annual management fee shared among owners in property specific LLCs
product_category: Fractional ranch and recreational land co-ownership

founders.name: Josh Green
prior_employers: Aerospace manufacturer (former CFO and EVP, per YC page)

founders.name: Mason Meier
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder on the YC launch post; listed under Former Founders. No bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real estate and legal structuring with a marketing site; little engineering difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: LLC structuring and management experience help, but fractional ownership of land is a copyable service model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pacaso focused on second homes and laid off staff in October 2022; no source shows it entering ranches.

market_need_then: Fractional ownership of homes was drawing venture funding in 2021 (for example Fractional raised a seed in November 2021 per Inman), but no ranch specific demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used pursuit-properties.com; YC page also lists hearthcoownership.com for the Hearth dba.

identity.logo: Black and white wordmark per the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Aspirational: a slice of beauty and solitude

branding.brand_signature: A slice of beauty and solitude tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Featured on the Ranch Investor podcast; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and niche appeal but a generic name and a dba, Hearth, that splits the identity.

pivots.to: Co-ownership and management of large ranches
pivots.why: Founder Josh Green said on a podcast that the marketplace still exists but the business is now co-ownership and ongoing management; date not stated.

outcome_analysis: Pursuit sold one eighth shares of large ranches with ongoing management, and its site still showed five listings with a 2024 footer. The YC directory marks it inactive, but no shutdown, sale or cause was found, so the cause of any failure is not public and no factors are asserted. Funding sources conflict, one showing 1 million and another 10 million dollars in early 2022.
notes: Both rounds rest on single databases (Caplight and Extruct) and conflict on amount and date; the 10 million figure in particular is unverified and may be a mislabel. Crunchbase returned 403 and was not worked around. YC status Inactive conflicts with a live looking website; exit set to unknown. Competition list left empty: the fractional ownership results found were undated or later. Founder Mason Meier role and education unknown.
